name: Oriel Edict-Keeper
firstAppearance: Campaign 02: Trial of the Celestial Heights
lore: Oriel stores verdicts about which Realms may intervene when Gates destabilize. Oriel is not a hero; Oriel is a lawful voice inside the hierarchy of radiant survival.
personality: Calm, absolute, compassionate only inside the limits of law.
physicalDescription: Androgynous celestial official with aura-spine geometry, white-gold armor robes, luminous scroll wings, and a faceless law-mask.
gameplayFunction: Rule explanation, deployment restriction voice, Empyrean codex source.
